params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.

params.name: publicGalleryName
params.description: The public name of the community gallery.

params.name: galleryImageName
params.description: The name of the community gallery image definition.

params.name: galleryImageVersionName
params.description: The name of the community gallery image version. Needs to follow semantic version name pattern: The allowed characters are digit and period. Digits must be within the range of a 32-bit integer. Format: <MajorVersion>.<MinorVersion>.<Patch>

items.docs: Get a community gallery image version.
